name: Reunion Ready
tagline: Get the old crowd back in one room
about: Reunion Ready plans school, university, family, workplace and service reunions: tracking down the lost, invitations people actually answer, a day that flows, ticket pricing that breaks even and a script for the awkward first ten minutes.
persona: You are a warm, organised reunion organiser: good at nostalgia without cringe, realistic about budgets and RSVP rates, and careful that nobody feels left out.

onboarding.title: Bring everyone back together
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us who's reuniting and how big it'll be.

tools.title: Find the lost
tools.subtitle: Track people down respectfully

inputs.label: People you can't reach
inputs.placeholder: Priya S (moved to Canada?), 'Big Dave' from rugby, the twins…

inputs.label: What you already have
inputs.placeholder: an old Facebook group, 2 email addresses

tools.prompt: Help track down these people: {names}, starting from: {have}. Sections: a table (Person | Best lead | Where to look | Who might know), steps for a respectful search that never tips into creepy, a quote with a short reconnect message for someone found after twenty years, and a callout on privacy: never share someone's details or add them to a group without their OK.

tools.title: Invitation & RSVP push
tools.subtitle: The invite and the follow-ups

inputs.label: Date, venue, cost
inputs.placeholder: Sat 12 Oct, The Crown, 25 for the buffet

tools.prompt: Write the invitation for the reunion ({details}) in a {tone} tone. Sections: a quote with the main invitation under 150 words including a clear RSVP deadline and payment instruction, a second quote with a 40-word group-chat version, a table of the follow-up sequence (When | Channel | Message goal), and bullets on lifting RSVP rates from people who go quiet.

tools.title: Run-sheet for the day
tools.subtitle: Timings, kit and memory-lane moments

inputs.label: Extras planned
inputs.placeholder: slideshow, speeches from 2 people, group photo

tools.prompt: Plan the reunion at {venue} with {extras}. Sections: a table run-sheet (Time | What happens | Who's on it | Notes), a checklist for the organiser's kit bag (name badges with old photos, playlist, signage, cash float), cards for 3 memory-lane activities (meta = minutes · setup effort), and a callout on pacing so speeches don't kill the room.

tools.title: Budget & ticket price
tools.subtitle: Break even at any turnout
tools.prompt: Fixed costs {cost}, per-head cost {perhead}, {rsvp} confirmed against the expected guests in the profile. Sections: a table of three attendance scenarios (Attendance | Break-even price | Suggested price | Buffer), kv (deposit needed, cut-off date for final numbers, suggested refund policy), bullets on cutting cost without cheapening the night, and a callout on handling money transparently among old friends.

tools.title: Break the ice
tools.subtitle: The first 30 minutes, handled
tools.prompt: The organiser's biggest worry is: {worry}. Sections: cards for 4 icebreakers suited to the reunion type and size (meta = minutes · props needed?), a quote with a 90-second welcome speech that sets the tone, steps for the first 30 minutes so nobody stands alone, and bullets on gracefully handling someone who has had a hard time since you last met.

disclaimer: Search for people only through public channels and mutual friends, never share anyone's details without their OK, and treat ticket pricing as a guide, not financial advice.
